episode.title: Voyages of Zheng He
episode.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, Admiral Zheng He led seven maritime expeditions, expanding China's influence and trade across Asia and Africa.

storyline.title: Introduction
storyline.desc: Facilitator introduces the historical context of the Ming Dynasty and the significance of maritime exploration.

storyline.title: Commissioning of the Fleet
storyline.desc: Emperor Yongle commissions Zheng He to lead a grand fleet to explore and establish trade routes.

storyline.title: First Voyage
storyline.desc: Zheng He embarks on his first voyage, reaching Southeast Asia and establishing diplomatic relations.

storyline.title: Expanding Horizons
storyline.desc: Subsequent voyages take Zheng He to South Asia, the Middle East, and the East African coast, showcasing China's naval power.

storyline.title: Challenges and Achievements
storyline.desc: The fleet faces challenges such as piracy and navigation difficulties but achieves significant diplomatic and trade successes.

storyline.title: Legacy and Impact
storyline.desc: Zheng He's voyages enhance China's prestige and influence, leaving a lasting legacy on global maritime history.

user_role.name: Zheng He
user_role.title: Admiral
user_role.desc: The charismatic and skilled leader of the treasure fleet, known for his diplomatic acumen and navigation expertise.
